csv_scope_of_work: South Bass Island State Park boat launch - Design improvements to launch ramp, protective pier, and adjacent shoreline to improve safety, accessibility, and operational capacity. East Harbor State Park campground and marina boat launch - Campground launch- design improvements to both launch lanes, evaluate the courtesy docks for repair or replacement, and provide a visual assessment of the adjacent seawall. title: A/E for Statewide Boating Access - North Shore
short_description: Design improvements for multiple boat launch ramps, docks, seawalls, and related shoreline structures.
project_location: Put-In-Bay, Ottawa County, Ohio, USA; includes South Bass Island State Park and East Harbor State Park.
project_scope: The project covers design improvements for boating access facilities at multiple state park sites on Ohio's North Shore. At South Bass Island State Park boat launch, the scope includes improvements to the launch ramp, protective pier, and adjacent shoreline to improve safety, accessibility, and operational capacity; development of alternatives for widening the ramp to allow two simultaneous launch lanes; and recommendation of an optimal courtesy dock configuration for either a single-lane or dual-lane layout. At East Harbor State Park campground and marina boat launch, the campground launch scope includes improvements to both launch lanes, evaluation of courtesy docks for repair or replacement, and a visual assessment of the adjacent seawall. The marina launch scope includes full replacement design of the ramp and assessment of abutments for possible repair or replacement, excluding the adjacent boat lift or well.
services: A/E services including civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, materials testing, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a marine/boating access and shoreline infrastructure project rather than a bridge or long-span structure.
- Includes some structural elements such as protective pier, courtesy docks, seawall assessment, and abutment assessment.
- Planning/design scope is present, which is more relevant than pure construction.
- Structural complexity appears moderate and no notable spans, innovative systems, or lightweight structures are indicated.
- Not a framework agreement, but the technical focus is outside sbp's core priorities.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. Available cost basis for a rough estimate is a total construction cost of 10.9 million USD covering multiple boating access sites and multidisciplinary A/E services.
